description: All live coupon codes and deals for one store, best first. The store can be a name ("Nike"), a domain ("nike.com"), a URL, or a Papyras store slug. Each offer shows whether the network marked it verified and what shoppers reported. Also returns the store's shipping and returns policy (free-shipping minimum, delivery, return window and cost, refunds) with its source page and last-rechecked date, when we have it.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (US, UK, DE, …) to prefer stores that serve that country. Worldwide stores are always included.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 10, max 50).

store.description: Store name, domain, URL or slug.

name: get_store_offers
title: Coupons for a store
